subject: physics
question_text: State the units and dimensions of the universal gravitational constant G.

verification.note: The mark split is invented and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. The question itself is sourced, not invented. AI physics check 2026-08-24: formulas, signs, numbers and claims verified against NCERT Class-11 conventions; corrections applied to explanation text (why / common_mistakes / memory_tip), marked answer lines unchanged unless factually wrong.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The SI unit
lines: Rearranging F = G m₁m₂ / r² for G gives
G = F r² / (m₁ m₂), so the unit is
steps.why: Rearranging the law of gravitation for G is quicker and safer than trying to remember either answer on its own.
common_mistakes: Writing N m kg⁻² and losing the square on the metre.
Giving the unit of g instead — g is an acceleration (m s⁻², dimensions [L T⁻²]); G is the constant in F = Gm₁m₂/r², with unit N m² kg⁻².

recall.must_convey: That the SI unit of G is newton metre squared per kilogram squared.
accept: newton metre squared per kilogram squared
N m squared kg to the minus two
reject: M to the minus one L cubed T to the minus two

steps.memory_tip: Do not memorise the unit — rearrange G = Fr²/m₁m₂ and read it off: N m² kg⁻².
steps.margin_note: First mark. Show G = Fr²/(m₁m₂) above the unit, then read the unit off it.

steps.label: The dimensions
steps.why: G is a constant of nature, so these dimensions never change however the formula is written.
common_mistakes: Giving [M L³ T⁻²] with the mass power positive.

recall.must_convey: That the dimensional formula of G is M to the minus one, L cubed, T to the minus two.
accept: M to the minus one L cubed T to the minus two
M inverse L cubed T inverse squared
reject: newton metre squared per kilogram squared

steps.memory_tip: Same method with brackets: [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²].
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The same rearrangement in brackets. Keep the power on M negative.

insider_note: Unit and dimensions are one mark each and one cannot replace the other; the negative power in [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²] is the part checked.
